strengths: Correctly captures monocyte/myeloid lineage using strong markers FCN1, CD14, S100A8, S100A9.
Uses negative marker reasoning (absence of FCGR3A/CD16) to exclude intermediate/non-classical monocytes.
weaknesses: Top1 label is ancestor-level monocyte; the more specific classical monocyte identity is only implicit in reasoning/top2.

strengths: Consistent with monocyte lineage supported by FCN1, CD14, S100A8, S100A9, LYZ, CST3.
Includes classical monocyte as rank2, aligning with subtype-specific evidence.
weaknesses: Top1 label lacks subtype specificity; classical monocyte is present only as secondary candidate.

strengths: Provides the most specific, ontology-valid descendant (CL:0000860) directly supported by FCN1, CD14, S100A8, S100A9, and absence of FCGR3A.
Directly distinguishes classical monocytes from other CD14+ cell types.
weaknesses: Relies on the same marker set as other reviewers; no fully independent functional assay separates monocyte vs classical monocyte.

supporting: Top DEGs FCN1, CD14, S100A8, S100A9, LYZ, CST3, SERPINA1, CFD directly support classical monocyte identity.
Absence of FCGR3A/CD16 in the marker panel supports the CD14++CD16- classical monocyte subtype.
PMID 34680286 supports monocyte/classical monocyte identity in human blood.
enrichment_or_literature: MHC class II antigen presentation and phagocytosis terms are consistent with monocyte biology and do not indicate a separate lineage.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, evidence, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
